info.title: Wallet Service API
info.description: Wallet Service API for user account and wallets management

get.description: Retrieve wallet information for the authenticated user
Retrieve transaction history for the authenticated user's wallet

post.description: Deposit asset to authenticated user's wallet account

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
DepositAssetRequest initiates a deposit of assets into the user's wallet account.
Note: Using string for amount to avoid floating-point precision issues in financial calculations.

post.description: Exchange one asset for another within authenticated user's wallet

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: ExchangeAssetRequest initiates an exchange of one asset for another within the user's wallet.

get.description: Query TigerBeetle transfers for a specific account with filtering options

post.description: Fetch specific TigerBeetle transfers by their IDs

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
LookupTransfersRequest fetches specific transfers by their IDs.
This is the most efficient way to retrieve known transfers.

post.description: Query TigerBeetle transfers by metadata, ledger, code, and other criteria

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
QueryTransfersRequest queries transfers by metadata and other filter criteria.
Useful for finding transfers by custom user_data fields or ledger/code combinations.
Field ordering optimized for Go memory alignment: bytes → uint64 → uint32 → bool.

post.description: Transfer asset from authenticated user's wallet to another user's wallet

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: TransferAssetRequest initiates a transfer of assets from the user's wallet to another user's wallet.

post.description: Withdraw asset from authenticated user's wallet account

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: WithdrawAssetRequest initiates a withdrawal of assets from the user's wallet account.

created_at.title: Timestamp when the transaction was created in the wallet service

ledger.title: Ledger identifier for asset isolation (matches Transfer.ledger)

identifier.title: Unique external identifier for the transaction (ULID format)

asset.title: Asset code involved in the transaction (e.g., "USD", "EUR", "BTC")

debit_account_id.title: External identifier of the debit account (maps to wallet_account.identifier)

credit_account_id.title: External identifier of the credit account (maps to wallet_account.identifier)

amount.title:
Transaction amount as a decimal string for precision (e.g., "100.50")
Note: Use string instead of float to avoid precision loss in financial calculations

fee.title: Transaction fee as a decimal string for precision (e.g., "1.50")

protoTransaction.description:
Transaction represents a high-level financial transaction in the wallet service.
This is the application-layer representation that maps to one or more TigerBeetle transfers.
Field ordering optimized for Go memory alignment.

id.title: Unique identifier for this transfer (128-bit, immutable)

debit_account_id.title: Account from which funds are debited (128-bit account ID)

credit_account_id.title: Account to which funds are credited (128-bit account ID)

amount.title: Amount to transfer in the smallest unit of the asset (128-bit for precision)

pending_id.title: Reference to a pending transfer ID for two-phase commit operations (0 if not applicable)

user_data_128.title: Custom 128-bit metadata field for application-specific data (e.g., transaction reference)

timestamp.title: Timestamp when the transfer was committed in TigerBeetle (nanoseconds since epoch)

user_data_64.title: Custom 64-bit metadata field for application-specific data (e.g., user ID)

timeout.title: Timeout for pending transfers in seconds (0 for immediate transfers)

ledger.title: Ledger identifier to isolate different asset types or business domains

code.title: Transfer code for categorizing transaction types (e.g., 718 for payment)

flags.title:
flags for transfer behavior (linked, pending, post_pending, void_pending, etc.)
Note: uint16 in TigerBeetle, but proto3 uses uint32 for compatibility

user_data_32.title: Custom 32-bit metadata field for application-specific data (e.g., transaction type)

protoTransfer.description:
Transfer represents a TigerBeetle transfer (financial transaction) with exact field mapping.
Field ordering optimized for Go memory alignment: 8-byte → 4-byte → 2-byte → 1-byte fields.
This message directly maps to TigerBeetle's Transfer structure for ledger operations.

amount.title:
Amount to transfer as a decimal string (e.g., "25.00")
Use string instead of float to maintain precision

receiver_wallet_identifier.title: External identifier (ULID) of the recipient's wallet

protoTransferAssetRequest.description: TransferAssetRequest initiates a transfer of assets from the user's wallet to another user's wallet.

error.title: Indicates whether an error occurred during processing

transaction.title: Transaction record for the transfer (null if error is true)

message.title: Human-readable message: error description if error=true, success message if error=false

protoTransferAssetResponse.description:
TransferAssetResponse returns the result of a transfer operation.
Field ordering optimized for Go memory alignment: bool → Transaction (pointer) → string.

linked.title: Link this transfer to the next transfer in a batch (atomic execution)

pending.title: Mark this transfer as pending (two-phase commit)

balancing_debit.title: Automatically balance the debit side if amount exceeds available balance

balancing_credit.title: Automatically balance the credit side if amount exceeds available balance

closing_debit.title: Close the debit account after this transfer (final transaction)

closing_credit.title: Close the credit account after this transfer (final transaction)

imported.title: Mark this transfer as imported from an external system (audit trail)

protoTransferFlags.description:
TransferFlags represents the individual flag bits for Transfer.flags field.
These flags control transfer behavior and state in TigerBeetle.

created_at.title: Timestamp when the wallet was created in the system

updated_at.title: Timestamp when the wallet was last updated (null if never updated)

deleted_at.title: Timestamp when the wallet was soft-deleted (null if active)

expires_at.title: Expiration timestamp for temporary or time-limited wallets (null if permanent)

banned.title: Indicates whether the wallet is banned due to policy violations or fraud

identifier.title: Unique external identifier for the wallet (ULID format for sortable, globally unique IDs)

title.title: Human-readable name or label for the wallet (e.g., "Main Wallet", "Savings")

description.title: Optional description providing additional context about the wallet's purpose

status.title: Current lifecycle status of the wallet (PENDING, ISSUED, ACTIVE)

user_identifier.title: External identifier of the user who owns this wallet

asset_identifier.title: External identifier of the primary/base asset for this wallet (e.g., default currency)

meta_data.title: Flexible key-value metadata for storing custom attributes (e.g., tags, categories, limits)

protoWallet.description:
Wallet represents a user's wallet container that holds multiple asset accounts.
A wallet is the top-level entity that groups related wallet accounts for a single user.
Field ordering optimized for Go memory alignment: pointers/timestamps → bools → strings → maps.

protoWalletBalance.description: WalletBalance represents the balance of a wallet.

amount.title:
Amount to withdraw as a decimal string (e.g., "50.25")
Use string instead of float to maintain precision

error.title: Indicates whether an error occurred during processing

transaction.title: Transaction record for the withdrawal (null if error is true)

message.title: Human-readable message: error description if error=true, success message if error=false

protoWithdrawAssetResponse.description:
WithdrawAssetResponse returns the result of a withdrawal operation.
Field ordering optimized for Go memory alignment: bool → Transaction (pointer) → string.
